Title: Enacts the "New York state buy American cement act"
Summary: Enacts the "New York state buy American cement act" to require the use of American materials when soliciting for a contract for the purchase of cement by any department or agency of the state, municipality, public authority and the commissioner of transportation.
LawCode: Add §162-b, St Fin L; add §104-e, Gen Muni L; add §2877-b, Pub Auth L; add §12-b, Hway L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the state finance law, the general municipal law, the public authorities law and the highway law, in relation to enacting the "New York state buy American cement act"
